Project.NAME: media-analysis-platform
Project.keywords: media_asset, stored_object, collection, inbox, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, analysis_run_step, artifact, diagnostic, channel_account, channel_surface, operation_request, telegram, web, mcp
Project.annotation: Canonical GRACE graph for the single-user channel-aware media analysis target architecture.

M-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE.NAME: TargetArchitecture
M-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE.purpose: Own the from-scratch target product model, table set, API operation groups, DTO/type names, app boundaries, user flows, migration stages, and verification matrix.

contract-singleUserChannelAwareTarget.PURPOSE: Defines the target single-user, channel-aware architecture and supersedes older migration-era names when conflicts appear.

target-product-domain.PURPOSE: media_assets, stored_objects, collections, selection_snapshots, analysis_runs, artifacts, artifact_subjects, diagnostics, and retention are API-owned product state.

target-execution-domain.PURPOSE: analysis_run_steps, analysis_run_step_inputs, prerequisite planning, and worker internal APIs coordinate execution behind analysis_run.

target-channel-domain.PURPOSE: channel_accounts, channel_surfaces, channel_surface_subjects, and channel_surface_events persist external presentation and recovery state without mutating product lifecycle.

target-operations-domain.PURPOSE: operation_requests records idempotency and accepted mutation attempts for safe retries.

target-data-reset-policy.PURPOSE: Current local database contents are disposable; target implementation should prove clean reset/recreate and deterministic fixtures, not preservation of current rows.

target-coverageMatrix.PURPOSE: Maps source-plan requirements to implementation evidence, automated proof, QA proof, deterministic fixtures, and remaining coverage Beads.

M-CONTRACTS.NAME: Contracts
M-CONTRACTS.purpose: Own OpenAPI and shared schemas for the target product vocabulary plus explicit deprecated compatibility contracts.

export-mediaAssetSchemas.PURPOSE: Define media_asset create, read, list, delete, stored_object/origin metadata, status, retention, and diagnostics envelopes.

export-compatibilitySchemas.PURPOSE: Define deprecated media_item, source, selection, owner, and analysis_run_task compatibility mappings without adding target behavior.

export-collectionSchemas.PURPOSE: Define inbox, collection, collection item, version conflict, archive, restore, and membership mutation envelopes.

export-selectionSnapshotSchemas.PURPOSE: Define immutable selection snapshots, option snapshots, validation diagnostics, and sealed status.

export-analysisRunSchemas.PURPOSE: Define analysis_run creation, status, event, cancel, artifact summary, diagnostics summary, and idempotency envelopes.

export-stepInputSchemas.PURPOSE: Define analysis_run_step_input payloads for worker internal APIs.

export-artifactSchemas.PURPOSE: Define artifact metadata, preview, download resolution, retention status, artifact_subject lineage, and unavailable artifact diagnostics.

export-diagnosticSchemas.PURPOSE: Define stable diagnostic code, severity, subject, correlation, and safe context envelopes.

M-API-HTTP.NAME: ApiHttp
M-API-HTTP.purpose: Expose the public API for media_asset ingestion, collection management, selection_snapshot sealing, analysis_run lifecycle, artifact access, and diagnostics.

export-registerMediaAssetRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind add, list, get, and delete media_asset routes.

export-registerCompatibilityRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind deprecated media_items and selections routes only where transitional clients still require them.

export-registerCollectionRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind inbox and collection management routes.

export-registerSelectionSnapshotRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind immutable selection snapshot creation and read routes.

export-registerAnalysisRunRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind analysis_run create, read, list, events, and cancel routes.

export-registerArtifactRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind channel-account-scoped artifact preview and download-resolution routes.

export-registerTargetStepRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind target analysis_run_step claim, cancel-check, progress, and finalize routes.

export-registerChannelSurfaceRoutes.PURPOSE: Bind channel_surface list, active recovery, display-state, supersede, and event routes.

M-API-DOMAIN.NAME: ApiDomain
M-API-DOMAIN.purpose: Own product rules for channel-account access, ingestion, inbox membership, collection mutation, selection snapshot immutability, analysis_run lifecycle, prerequisite planning, retention, and diagnostics.

export-addMedia.PURPOSE: Normalize input into stored_object/media_asset records plus inbox membership.

export-manageCollection.PURPOSE: Apply versioned collection mutations and archive/delete rules.

export-createSelectionSnapshot.PURPOSE: Validate media_asset references and seal immutable selection snapshots.

export-createAnalysisRun.PURPOSE: Create analysis_run from selection_snapshot, plan analysis_run_steps, and declare analysis_run_step_inputs.

export-planPrerequisites.PURPOSE: Create prerequisite transcription steps or diagnostics for report and research work that needs transcript/text-corpus artifacts.

export-cancelAnalysisRun.PURPOSE: Apply cooperative cancellation against analysis_run and internal execution rows.

export-applyRetention.PURPOSE: Evaluate stored_object, media_asset, selection_snapshot, run, artifact, and diagnostics retention actions.

export-recordDiagnostic.PURPOSE: Persist safe diagnostic evidence for rejected and partial flows.

export-recordWorkerArtifacts.PURPOSE: Persist worker artifact registrations as stored_objects, artifacts, and artifact_subject lineage keyed by analysis_run_step_id.

export-targetRuntimeService.PURPOSE: Routes target operations through apps/api/internal/storage/target.Store while compatibility services remain available for deprecated clients.

M-API-STORAGE.NAME: ApiStorage
M-API-STORAGE.purpose: Persist channel_accounts, operation_requests, stored_objects, media_assets, collections, collection_items, selection_snapshots, selection_snapshot_items, analysis_runs, analysis_run_steps, analysis_run_step_inputs, analysis_run_events, artifacts, artifact_subjects, diagnostics, channel_surfaces, channel_surface_subjects, and channel_surface_events.

migration-targetReset.PURPOSE: Destructively resets disposable local storage and recreates the target channel-aware table set.

repository-targetStore.PURPOSE: Provides target SQL repository methods for channel accounts, operation requests, media assets with inbox membership, collections, selection snapshots, analysis run graphs/events/step lifecycle, artifacts, diagnostics, and channel surfaces.

table-channelAccounts.PURPOSE: Store durable channel identity and access scope for the single-user product.

table-operationRequests.PURPOSE: Store idempotency and accepted mutation attempts for safe retries.

table-storedObjects.PURPOSE: Store object body and origin metadata.

table-collections.PURPOSE: Store inbox and named collection metadata with optimistic versions.

table-selectionSnapshots.PURPOSE: Store immutable item and option snapshots.

table-selectionSnapshotItems.PURPOSE: Store ordered copied media_asset item snapshots.

table-analysisRuns.PURPOSE: Store public run lifecycle and evidence gate state.

table-analysisRunSteps.PURPOSE: Store internal execution steps behind analysis_run.

table-analysisRunStepInputs.PURPOSE: Store explicit selection item or artifact inputs for each worker step.

table-artifacts.PURPOSE: Store output metadata and retention state.

table-artifactSubjects.PURPOSE: Store artifact lineage links to runs, steps, snapshots, selected items, media assets, and diagnostics.

table-diagnostics.PURPOSE: Store structured warnings, errors, and operator evidence.

table-channelSurfaces.PURPOSE: Store restart-safe channel presentation mappings with active uniqueness by channel account, surface key, and address fingerprint.

table-channelSurfaceSubjects.PURPOSE: Store external surface links to target product subjects while enforcing one primary subject per surface.

table-channelSurfaceEvents.PURPOSE: Store append-only channel surface lifecycle and recovery history.

M-API-QUEUE.NAME: ApiQueue
M-API-QUEUE.purpose: Expose internal analysis_run_step control-plane and bounded queue recovery without defining public product vocabulary.

export-enqueueAnalysisRunSteps.PURPOSE: Create queue messages for planned analysis_run_steps.

export-enqueueRetentionWork.PURPOSE: Schedule stored object and artifact cleanup when retention policy allows it.

M-API-EVENTS.NAME: ApiEvents
M-API-EVENTS.purpose: Publish polling and live-update event surfaces for media_asset, collection, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, and diagnostic changes.

export-runEvents.PURPOSE: Expose analysis_run status, diagnostic, and artifact events.

export-collectionEvents.PURPOSE: Expose inbox and collection mutation events for adapters that subscribe.

M-INTERACTION-SURFACES.NAME: ChannelSurfaces
M-INTERACTION-SURFACES.purpose: Persist channel-account-scoped external channel surfaces without adding consumer-specific fields to domain entities.

contract-interactionSurfaces.PURPOSE: Historical interaction-surface contract being generalized into channel_surfaces, channel_surface_subjects, and channel_surface_events.

table-channelSurfaces.PURPOSE: Store channel_account, channel, surface type, surface key, opaque address, address fingerprint, opaque display state, lifecycle status, version, idempotency, and lifecycle timestamps.

table-channelSurfaceSubjects.PURPOSE: Store surface-to-domain-subject links with subject type, subject id, and subject role while enforcing one primary subject per surface.

table-channelSurfaceEvents.PURPOSE: Store append-only operational history for created, upserted, address changed, display state replaced, superseded, deleted, failed, and recovered events.

internal-upsertSurface.PURPOSE: Allow channel runtimes to create or update durable external channel surfaces idempotently; repeat upserts return the actual persisted row and rebind subject links to it.

internal-listSurfaces.PURPOSE: Allow channel runtimes to recover active external surfaces after restart.

internal-supersedeSurface.PURPOSE: Allow channel runtimes to retire stale or uneditable external surfaces without deleting domain history.

M-WORKER-TRANSCRIPTION.NAME: WorkerTranscription
M-WORKER-TRANSCRIPTION.purpose: Execute transcription steps from sealed selection material and publish artifacts through analysis_run.

export-processStepInputs.PURPOSE: Process declared selection_snapshot_item inputs from sealed selection_snapshot facts without reading mutable collection state.

export-publishArtifacts.PURPOSE: Publish transcript artifacts and artifact_subject lineage through API-owned artifact contracts.

export-stepCancellation.PURPOSE: Use analysis_run_step cancel-check and finalization contracts for cooperative cancellation.

M-WORKER-AGENT-RUNNER.NAME: WorkerAgentRunner
M-WORKER-AGENT-RUNNER.purpose: Execute report and research analysis from ready transcript or text-corpus artifacts and publish artifacts plus diagnostics through analysis_run.

export-runAnalysisHarness.PURPOSE: Dispatch configured analysis harnesses behind analysis_run.

export-consumePreparedText.PURPOSE: Consume declared transcript_artifact or text_corpus_artifact step inputs by materializing them as harness input artifacts instead of transcribing or discovering raw speech media.

export-publishAnalysisArtifacts.PURPOSE: Publish report, research, log, and diagnostic artifacts.

export-stepRequestAccess.PURPOSE: Resolve private operation envelopes by analysis_run_step_id.

M-WEB.NAME: Web
M-WEB.purpose: Provide a simple human-facing management UI over API-owned materials, groups, current selection, progress, results, errors, downloads, and retention.

export-targetApiClient.PURPOSE: Call target media_asset, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, and diagnostic routes with channel_account_id scope.

view-materials.PURPOSE: Browse and filter user materials with clear human labels.

view-selectionBuilder.PURPOSE: Create immutable selections from ordered items while hiding internal snapshot terminology.

view-runDetail.PURPOSE: Show progress, results, errors, and downloads without load-bearing internal vocabulary.

M-TELEGRAM-ADAPTER.NAME: TelegramAdapter
M-TELEGRAM-ADAPTER.purpose: Capture Telegram input and present inbox, collection, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, and diagnostic actions over the shared API state.

export-addMediaFromUpdate.PURPOSE: Convert Telegram updates into target media_asset creation and upload requests scoped by channel_account.

export-renderInboxStatus.PURPOSE: Show accepted inputs and available management actions.

export-runAnalysisAction.PURPOSE: Create a selection_snapshot and analysis_run from explicit user action.

export-targetTelegramVocabulary.PURPOSE: Use media_asset_id, selection_snapshot_id, and channel_account_id in active Telegram API request and callback paths.

export-channelSurfaceRecovery.PURPOSE: Persist current materials panels, active run cards, and result artifact deliveries through channel_surfaces and recover them after restart.

export-resultDeliveryDeduplication.PURPOSE: Use result_artifact_surface records to avoid duplicate Telegram result delivery after restart without mutating product lifecycle.

contract-selectionTranscriptionCards.PURPOSE: Define Telegram user-facing card copy, buttons, current selection behavior, task card lifecycle, recent-task navigation, and interaction-surface requirements.

M-MCP-ADAPTER.NAME: McpAdapter
M-MCP-ADAPTER.purpose: Expose MCP tools over the same API-owned product state.

tool-createMediaAsset.PURPOSE: Create media_asset records through target channel_account_id schemas.

tool-listMediaAssets.PURPOSE: List and search media_asset records through target API operations.

tool-getDiagnostics.PURPOSE: Read diagnostics for media_asset, selection_snapshot, run, and artifact subjects.

M-COVERAGE.NAME: TargetCoverage
M-COVERAGE.purpose: Own the target rebuild coverage matrix, deterministic fixture catalog, and fresh schema reset smoke used by the coverage and QA epics.

fixture-manifest.PURPOSE: Defines stable channel_account, collection, media_asset, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, and stored_object fixture ids.

fixture-objectStore.PURPOSE: Stores deterministic object-store bytes with manifest sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

script-targetResetSmoke.PURPOSE: Applies target migration twice to fresh Postgres, validates target/legacy table state, checks selection_snapshot triggers, and inserts deterministic channel/inbox seed.

test-fixtureValidation.PURPOSE: Validates fixture manifest vocabulary, channel identities, object-store files, sizes, and hashes.
